metadata.title: BSVibe monorepo layout and local stack

text: BSVibe is implemented as a unified monorepo with a FastAPI backend and Next.js PWA. The README documents Docker Compose startup, backend health probe, PWA entrypoint, and test commands, so source-derived RAG should include both implementation and operational setup context.

metadata.title: KnowledgeFactory binds knowledge to workspace and region

text: KnowledgeFactory is the central per-workspace/per-region constructor. It roots every vault at region/workspace_id, exposes workspace-scoped Vault and GardenWriter objects, and constructs the workspace-scoped retriever used by runtime components. This makes workspace scoping a first-class RAG metadata requirement.

metadata.title: Canonical concept retrieval uses promoted active concepts only

text: CanonConceptRetriever extracts candidate tags from work signals, resolves them through the canonicalization index, and returns active concept display statements. It is bounded, workspace-scoped, graceful-empty, and never raises into verification, so promoted concepts should be separated from raw notes in the dataset.

metadata.title: Resolved decisions are retrieved from settled garden notes

text: ResolvedDecisionsRetriever reads decision_resolution notes from garden/seedling, filters out tombstoned notes, matches signal tokens against question, answer, and intent text, and emits prior decision statements. This confirms that decision memories are a concrete source type for BSVibe RAG.

metadata.title: Negative patterns preserve founder rejection feedback

text: NegativePatternRetriever reads negative_pattern garden notes emitted when a founder discards a deliverable with a reason. It surfaces relevant avoid guidance by signal overlap, which means rejected approaches should be modeled as their own retrieval source instead of mixed into generic notes.

metadata.title: Composite retriever merges multiple knowledge sources behind one protocol

text: CompositeCanonRetriever combines several CanonRetriever sources, dedupes statements, preserves source order, caps total output, and degrades when one source fails. The RAG dataset should therefore track note_type/source_type so retrieval can rank canonical concepts before decisions and negative patterns.

metadata.title: Agent runtime wires workspace retriever into execution and knowledge-only route

text: The agent runtime builds a workspace-scoped KnowledgeFactory retriever, optionally composes SemanticNoteRetriever when embeddings are configured, injects retriever into executor/native loops, and routes knowledge_only frames to KnowledgeAnswerOrchestrator. This proves RAG context is consumed at runtime, not only stored.

metadata.title: Settle worker writes vault notes, promotes concepts, and embeds notes

text: Worker runtime constructs SettleWorker with KnowledgeSettleSink, entity extractor fallback, garden promoter factory, and note embedding hook. This is the ingestion path that turns workflow activity into vault knowledge and vector-searchable notes.

metadata.title: IngestCompiler compiles imported seed content per chunk

text: IngestCompiler splits seed items into chunks, emits progress events, finds related context once per chunk, plans updates with an LLM, and writes notes. The code explicitly warns not to hoist related-context lookup outside the chunk loop, so cleaned data should retain chunk-level provenance.

metadata.title: Chunking budget protects local LLM ingestion

text: The chunking module uses a conservative default char budget, reserves model context for prompts/output, caps Ollama budgets, truncates oversized items, and separates partitioning from retrieval. This supports RAG data cleaning rules around chunk size and local-model constraints.

metadata.title: Semantic note retrieval searches pgvector note embeddings

text: SemanticNoteRetriever embeds incoming signals and searches a NoteVectorBackend, while PgNoteVectorBackend stores/searches note_embeddings by workspace_id and embedding_model using pgvector cosine distance. Semantic search is auxiliary, capped, similarity-filtered, and workspace-scoped.

metadata.title: PWA Knowledge API exposes concepts, observations, graph, retract, and correct

text: The PWA knowledge API calls /api/v1/inside endpoints for canonical concepts, observations, graph data, concept detail, retract/correct actions, and undo. This defines the user-facing source categories that the RAG dataset should preserve for inspection and correction workflows.

metadata.title: Knowledge graph view presents ontology nodes and inspector actions

text: KnowledgeGraphView renders a full-screen force-directed graph over /api/v1/inside data, supports type/community color modes, opens concept detail in an inspector, and tracks local retract/correct visual state until backend refresh. This confirms graph and correction metadata matter for analysis.

metadata.title: MCP domain tools define search, graph, tag, and create-note surfaces

text: The knowledge MCP domain tools define schemas for search_knowledge, get_note, get_graph_context, list_recent, list_by_tag, list_tags, browse_communities, browse_entity, and create_note. RAG data should preserve tool-facing fields like path, preview, tags, graph context, and audit source.

metadata.title: Cross-run decision reuse is tested through seed and verification fold

text: The B13 glue test resolves a decision through the API, drains SettleWorker into the vault, constructs a fresh KnowledgeFactory retriever for a second run, and asserts the prior decision appears in both first-turn LLM messages and persisted verification contract. This is strong evidence that decision memory is runtime-critical data.

metadata.title: RetractionService orchestrates ontology corrections with a 30s undo window

text: RetractionService persists a RetractionSignal to ontology_corrections, opens a 30s DB-backed undo window, and lets apply_pending sweep tombstone the note via GardenWriter once the deadline passes. Issue and undo are idempotent on signal id, and the per-workspace _garden_lock prevents interleaving with concurrent canon merges or settle writes.

metadata.title: GardenObservationPromoter turns recurring garden tags into canonical anchors

text: GardenObservationPromoter scans garden notes, drops structural tags, keeps only tags that recur above a minimum threshold, seeds create-concept actions, runs a deterministic trigram-Jaccard proposer to detect lexical variants, and emits merge-concepts proposals. Safe Mode keeps proposals queued; permissive mode auto-applies them so retrieval can collapse variant spellings onto one node.

metadata.title: canon-lint surfaces orphan tags, alias collisions, and redirect anomalies

text: The lint module scans the canonicalization index and note store to emit read-only findings: orphan garden tags, alias collisions across active concepts, and redirect chain anomalies including cycles and missing targets. Findings carry severity (error vs warning) but never mutate the vault; the canon-lint plugin renders them as a markdown report.

metadata.title: CanonWatcher bridges external vault edits into the canonicalization index

text: CanonWatcher uses a watchdog Observer to detect external edits under concepts/, proposals/, actions/, and decisions/ paths and emits NOTE_UPDATED or NOTE_DELETED events. CanonicalizationIndexSubscriber listens and invalidates the affected paths. Self-host only and gated by runtime_config.canon_watcher_enabled; SaaS deployments where every write flows through the API leave it disabled.

metadata.title: Graph analytics expose centrality, components, and knowledge gaps

text: The analytics module sits on top of any GraphBackend and computes NetworkX-powered metrics: degree, betweenness, and pure-Python PageRank per node; density, connected components, average degree, and isolated nodes at the graph level. It exposes hub nodes and thin communities so downstream UI can surface god nodes and knowledge gaps without pulling scipy or numpy.

metadata.title: GraphExtractor pulls entities and relations from vault frontmatter and wikilinks

text: GraphExtractor is the rule-based extractor that turns vault notes into GraphEntity and GraphRelationship records. It parses frontmatter while filtering out metadata keys that are not relation types, walks wikilink targets, and marks ambiguous targets with a trailing question mark. The output feeds the graph backend used by analytics and the PWA knowledge view.

metadata.title: RetractionSignal locks the wire shape of every founder-issued correction

text: RetractionSignal is the frozen, extra=forbid Pydantic model every retract or correct flows through end to end. Identity (id, workspace_id, actor_id) is the idempotency key; node_ref is the stable id from the Inside graph; apply_at = issued_at + 30s anchors the undo deadline. Reason is optional, 280 chars max, toast-friendly. The frozen contract is the audit record.

metadata.title: EventBus enumerates lifecycle, vault, and ingest events for streaming

text: The EventBus module defines EventType enums for plugin and skill lifecycle, vault writes (SEED_WRITTEN, GARDEN_WRITTEN, ACTION_LOGGED), vault mutations (NOTE_UPDATED, NOTE_DELETED), scheduler triggers, agent tool calls, and ingest compile batch events. Everything that needs to be surfaced as a real-time stream goes through one typed enum so the bus stays uniform across subsystems.

metadata.title: Audit events trace the ontology correction lifecycle through the outbox

text: The audit_events module defines three small AuditEventBase subclasses with pinned default event types: ontology.correction.requested (intake), ontology.correction.undone (founder undid in window), and ontology.correction.applied (tombstone committed). Payloads stay small while workspace, actor, and node attribution survive on every event so future audits can answer why a node disappeared.

metadata.title: Settle runtime factories build per-settlement extractor and embedding hook

text: settle_runtime exposes two factories the SettleWorker depends on: build_settle_entity_extractor_factory creates a per-settlement IngestCompiler routed through the same GatewayDispatcher the chat path uses with the workspace's single active non-executor account, and build_note_embed_hook embeds the absorbed note summary with the deployment embedder and upserts the vector into pgvector note_embeddings keyed by vault pa th.

metadata.title: Runtime dispatcher binds gateway plus cheap-LLM seams to the same per-session pattern

text: dispatcher builds the per-session GatewayDispatcher exactly as the chat API does and exposes _GatewayCompileLlm and _GatewayFrameLlm adapters for the settle entity extractor and the frame stage. Co-locating the three pieces keeps the workspace/account/model identity triple in one place and makes per-stage feature wiring explicit at every entrypoint.

metadata.title: RetractModal renders the pre-flight confirmation for an ontology retract

text: RetractModal is the founder-facing confirmation surface before a retract lands. It shows the node name, a calm one-sentence consequence, an optional reason field capped at 280 chars, and Cancel plus Retract actions. Cascade-dependents are wired structurally but hidden when empty. The modal owns only its UI state; the actual POST and toast wiring stay in the parent so retract and correct share one undo affordance.

metadata.title: InspectorActions runs the idle to modal to toast state machine for retract and correct

text: InspectorActions is the integration point between the Inside view inspector panel and the M3a write endpoints. It renders Correct and Retract buttons, drives the modals, and owns the 30 second undo toast lifecycle. The state machine moves idle to modal to toast countdown to toast terminal so the panel host stays read-shaped and only hands down a node ref plus an onAfterApply hook.

metadata.title: UndoToast derives the 30s countdown from server wall-clock apply_at

text: UndoToast renders a calm 30 second Undo affordance after a retract or correct lands. A 1000ms tick re-derives the remainder from apply_at minus now so a paused tab snaps back to the correct wall-clock remainder on resume. apply_at is the server-stamped ISO-8601 deadline from RetractionSignal; the client never trusts its own clock for issued_at, so a stale modal still gets the right remainder.

metadata.title: compose.prod.yaml overrides dev defaults for prod env-driven startup

text: compose.prod.yaml layers on top of compose.yaml. It substitutes env-driven values for BSVIBE_DATABASE_URL, redis url, KMS key, and Supabase config; drops public Postgres and Redis port publishing with the docker-compose !reset tag; sets BSVIBE_WORKER_MODE to db_polling; and pins GIT_SHA so the running stack reports its build. Required vars are marked with the ?:err syntax so missing secrets fail fast.

metadata.title: Deploy README documents the migrate-on-boot and single-migrator contract

text: deploy/README.md is the prod runbook. The backend image entrypoint runs alembic upgrade head exactly once and then execs uvicorn; on restart alembic sees alembic_version at head and no-ops. The worker container overrides the entrypoint and goes straight to python -m backend.workers, so the two containers never race the same migration.

metadata.title: Deploy README documents the migrate-on-boot and single-migrator contract

text: The runbook also lists the prerequisites, env-file workflow, and the PWA Vercel split.

metadata.title: Fact note frontmatter — typed triple with supersedes chain

text: Real fact note shape from extractor test fixture: frontmatter declares type=fact, subject/predicate/object as wikilinks, valid_from/valid_to, source_type=explicit, and supersedes a prior fact id. Body is the human-readable summary. Example: type: fact, title: 'Blasin의 현재 역할', subject: [[Blasin]], predicate: has_role, object: [[AX Team Lead]], valid_from: 2024-06, supersedes: [[fact-blasin-backend-dev]].

metadata.title: Fact note frontmatter — typed triple with supersedes chain

text: This is the canonical shape pgvector chunks must round-trip without dropping subject/predicate/object semantics.

metadata.title: Event note frontmatter — attendees and belongs_to wikilink lists

text: Real event note shape: type=event, title, attendees list of wikilinks, belongs_to list of wikilinks, optional knowledge_layer=episodic. Body holds free-form meeting notes. Example: type: event, title: 'Team Standup', attendees: [[Alice]], [[Bob]], belongs_to: [[Project X]]. RAG chunking must preserve list semantics so retrieval can answer 'who attended X' from the frontmatter, not just the body.

metadata.title: Person note frontmatter — related list with ambiguity marker

text: Real person note shape: type=person, title, related list of wikilinks where a trailing ? marks the link as AMBIGUOUS. Example: type: person, title: Bob, related: [[Alice]], [[Charlie]]?. The extractor turns related into related_to edges; ambiguous markers should propagate as a confidence field on the chunk metadata so retrieval can downweight uncertain links.

metadata.title: Seed note frontmatter — captured-at and source attribution

text: Real seed note shape written by GardenWriter.write_seed: type=seed, source (e.g. calendar/google-calendar), captured_at (ISO date), optional title and content. File path is seeds/{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM}.md. Body is either the explicit content field or a YAML dump of the data payload. RAG metadata should keep both source and captured_at so time-windowed retrieval (e.g. 'last week's meetings') is possible.
